research_question: Evaluate cross-instrument calibration and phase-stratified backtest on synthetic cycle 25 proxy data without claiming real solar-cycle prediction.

columns.description: Synthetic activity-phase label; not a target variable.

columns.description: Reference coordinate for this fixture only; not an absolute truth claim.

columns.description: Two rows are marked for sensitivity analysis.

recommended_checks_not_mandatory_methods: Preserve time order when separating calibration and evaluation data.
Compare uncalibrated and calibrated agreement on data not used to fit calibration parameters.
Repeat the analysis after excluding each suspect row separately and together.
Report both improvement and remaining error rather than only a correlation coefficient.
For phase-stratified backtest, keep early-phase calibration and late-phase evaluation disjoint.
unsupported_claims: No next-cycle amplitude target is present.
No causal instrument-aperture attribution can be established.
No real WSO or HMI performance claim is supported.
No Solar Cycle 26 forecast is supported.
handoff_note: The downstream automatic experiment agent should choose the concrete experiment design. These recommendations are quality constraints, not a fixed method route.
